description: Land Title Settlement Dept - Kudwaskaduwa, Kaluthara D/S/D, Kaluthara District (7897)
categorisation: The gazette content is exclusively about amending the registered title details (specifically a servitude right of access) for a specific parcel of land. It falls under the "PART III - LANDS" heading and is issued by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. This directly fits the definition of a **Land Gazette (Type 4)**, which covers land registrations, title amendments, and property-related legal notices.
